output.reason: The rendered diffs only show the storage flag moving from v2beta1 to v2 in 1.12.6 → 1.13.0 [ev-f0f21b325fa6] [ev-094d5d8b0291]. A validator confirmed that v2beta1 PolicyException is still an API version in both releases [ev-e4d8d307c8bd] [ev-f5ab4321b780], so it is still served and nothing fails, gets rejected or stops working in this upgrade. The change text puts the migration "before a later release removes v2beta1", so this upgrade does not require it. That makes the consequence a deprecation for review, not migration-required, which would wrongly classify it as mandatory work.

correction.statement: In 1.13.0 the storage version of policyexceptions.kyverno.io moves from v2beta1 to v2. v2beta1 is still served, and existing PolicyException objects keep working while still stored as v2beta1. They must be migrated before a later release removes v2beta1.

consequence.statement: Nothing fails in this release because v2beta1 is still served. Existing PolicyException objects stay stored as v2beta1 until they are rewritten. They will need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to a release that removes v2beta1, rewrite all policyexceptions.kyverno.io objects so they are stored as v2. Then remove v2beta1 from the CRD's status.storedVersions.
